title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout notice supports automatic availability with prerequisites, and the documented control paths and commands are correct. Minor corrections should acknowledge newer Android release notes and the differing scheduled-meeting licensing guidance, and remove the licence-assignment checklist step that has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: The Facilitator in Teams Rooms page names no meter or separate charge for in-person notes.

claims.claim: The Teams Rooms licences page states no price for Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms Pro in-person notes pricing meter charge. Read Microsoft Teams Rooms licenses in full: it describes Pro, purchase channels and Basic at no additional cost, but gives no numeric Pro price.

claims.claim: The Take notes setting is at Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: No API for the Take notes button setting is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Show Take notes button" PowerShell API Teams Rooms Android; Teams Rooms Pro Management Show Take notes button home screen API PowerShell XML configuration. Read Rooms Facilitator and XML/troubleshooting excerpts; no API found for this setting.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: The Pro Management portal Take notes setting is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Show Take notes button on the home screen. The default setting is enabled.

claims.claim: Learn gives the portal setting path without naming a platform in that step.
claims.quote: Step 4: Turn on note-taking for Teams Rooms. In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: Meeting transcription is controlled at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the Global meeting policy.
claims.quote: To allow everyone in your organization to transcribe meetings, events, and group calls, except users with an assigned custom meeting policy, run the following command: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The Rooms Facilitator setup directs readers to the general meeting-transcription policy.
claims.quote: Step 2: Turn on transcription for meetings. For more information, see Manage transcription for meetings.

claims.claim: The policy/account mapping specifically governing transcription for in-person notes is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator "in-person" "transcription" "policy" account. Read Rooms Facilitator setup and transcription guidance; general organizer/user rules exist, but no in-person mapping of room resource account versus participant adding their name was found.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: No admin-centre UI path is documented for the Teams IsLoopEnabled control.
claims.quote: Searched: "IsLoopEnabled" "IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled" admin center configure UI. Read the complete redirected Loop admin configuration page: Teams settings use SharePoint PowerShell; the admin-centre checkbox controls Loop workspaces, not IsLoopEnabled.

claims.where: controls[2].scope and note; Governance controls table
claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled applies tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: IsLoopEnabled (boolean) ... This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true enables collaborative meeting notes in Teams.
claims.quote: Enable Loop workspaces creation and Loop component creation and integration everywhere ... [Teams-only] Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true, Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true

claims.claim: No admin-centre UI path is documented for IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled.
claims.quote: Searched: "IsLoopEnabled" "IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled" admin center configure UI. Read the complete Loop admin configuration page and Facilitator skills setup; this property is managed with SharePoint PowerShell, not the Loop workspaces admin-centre checkbox.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled applies tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled does not apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.
